props.html:
Painting Mosman properly

Homes built to be looked at, painted to match

Drive up Military Road and you can read Mosman's history in its shopfronts. The awnings, the render, the early 1900s detailing: this is a suburb that takes its buildings seriously. So do we.

Mosman sits on a high peninsula between Sydney Harbour and Middle Harbour. That setting is the whole appeal. It is also hard on paint. Salt-laden air, harbour wind, shaded damp elevations and long stretches of intense UV all pull at a coating from different angles. A repaint that ignores that will look tired within a couple of seasons.

We prepare for the conditions the property actually faces. A harbour-facing weatherboard in Beauty Point does not get the same system as a sheltered interior off Raglan Street. Federation joinery gets treated with the care it needs, not a quick sand and a fresh coat over old problems. We work clean, we protect your home, and we quote a fixed price before a brush is opened.

Twenty years of Lower North Shore homes teaches you where the moisture hides. That is the experience you are hiring.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Common questions

Mosman painting FAQs

How much does a painter cost in Mosman?
It depends on the size of the job, the surfaces and the amount of preparation involved. Rather than guess, we give you a free, fixed-price quote in writing after seeing the property. There is no call-out fee, and the quoted price is what you pay. Call 0423 019 087 to book a look.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes in Mosman?
Yes. A large share of Mosman's homes are Federation, Arts and Crafts, Queen Anne or character properties. We prepare original timber carefully, protect existing detailing and work with period-suitable colour schemes so the result suits the house.
Do I need council approval to repaint a heritage property in Mosman?
Sometimes. Mosman has many heritage-listed properties and several heritage conservation areas, and repainting a listed building or a property in a conservation area can require council sign-off on colours. Straightforward maintenance repaints are often exempt. Check with Mosman Council first, and we are happy to work to an approved scheme once you have it.
What paint holds up best for Mosman's harbourside and salt air?
Exteriors near the water need mould-resistant, UV-stable systems, with corrosion protection on any metal. We match the coating to the surface and the exposure, so a harbour-facing weatherboard gets a tougher build-up than a sheltered wall. Good preparation matters just as much as the product.
Do you paint apartments and strata blocks in Mosman?
Yes. We handle unit interiors, whole apartments and strata common property, including blocks and townhouse complexes. For strata managers and committees we provide clear scopes and keep colour consistent across the property.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry full insurance. You are welcome to ask for details before we start.
Do you offer free quotes and fixed pricing?
Every quote is free and fixed price. We assess the job in person, put the price in writing, and that is the figure you pay. No call-out fee applies.
Is there a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to quote your Mosman job costs you nothing.
Which parts of Mosman do you cover?
All of Mosman, postcode 2088. That includes central Mosman and Military Road, plus the localities of Balmoral, Beauty Point, Clifton Gardens, Georges Heights and Spit Junction.
Can you match or restore an existing heritage colour scheme?
Yes. We can match an existing colour or help you choose a period-suitable scheme, and apply samples to the wall so you can see them in the light before committing.
How long will an exterior repaint last near the water?
With the right system and proper preparation, a quality exterior repaint gives you many years of service. Harbour exposure is demanding, so the honest answer depends on the surface, the aspect and how much sun and salt it copes with. We will talk you through realistic expectations for your specific property at quote time.
Do you handle access on steep or narrow Mosman streets?
Plenty of Mosman blocks are steep and tight, especially down toward Beauty Point and the harbour. Access and safe set-up are part of our planning, and we allow for it in the quote rather than springing it on you later.
How do I prepare my home before the painters arrive?
Not much is needed. Clear small valuables and give us access to the areas being painted. We handle the masking, covering and moving of larger items, and we protect floors and furniture as part of the job.
What are your hours, and do you work Saturdays?
We work 6am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday, and we are closed Sunday. Reach us on 0423 019 087 or through the quote form and we will reply within 2 business hours.

data.name: Sydney Paintmasters
data.description: Licensed painters serving Mosman 2088 and Sydney's Lower North Shore. Heritage and Federation homes, harbourside exteriors, interior, roof, strata, commercial and pool painting.

mainEntity.name: How much does a painter cost in Mosman?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the size of the job, the surfaces and the amount of preparation involved. Rather than guess, we give you a free, fixed-price quote in writing after seeing the property. There is no call-out fee, and the quoted price is what you pay. Call 0423 019 087 to book a look.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint heritage and Federation homes in Mosman?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A large share of Mosman's homes are Federation, Arts and Crafts, Queen Anne or character properties. We prepare original timber carefully, protect existing detailing and work with period-suitable colour schemes so the result suits the house.

mainEntity.name: Do I need council approval to repaint a heritage property in Mosman?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sometimes. Mosman has many heritage-listed properties and several heritage conservation areas, and repainting a listed building or a property in a conservation area can require council sign-off on colours. Straightforward maintenance repaints are often exempt. Check with Mosman Council first, and we are happy to work to an approved scheme once you have it.

mainEntity.name: What paint holds up best for Mosman's harbourside and salt air?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exteriors near the water need mould-resistant, UV-stable systems, with corrosion protection on any metal. We match the coating to the surface and the exposure, so a harbour-facing weatherboard gets a tougher build-up than a sheltered wall. Good preparation matters just as much as the product.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint apartments and strata blocks in Mosman?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We handle unit interiors, whole apartments and strata common property, including blocks and townhouse complexes. For strata managers and committees we provide clear scopes and keep colour consistent across the property.
Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and carry full insurance. You are welcome to ask for details before we start.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer free quotes and fixed pricing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every quote is free and fixed price. We assess the job in person, put the price in writing, and that is the figure you pay. No call-out fee applies.
No. Coming out to quote your Mosman job costs you nothing.

mainEntity.name: Which parts of Mosman do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: All of Mosman, postcode 2088. That includes central Mosman and Military Road, plus the localities of Balmoral, Beauty Point, Clifton Gardens, Georges Heights and Spit Junction.

mainEntity.name: Can you match or restore an existing heritage colour scheme?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can match an existing colour or help you choose a period-suitable scheme, and apply samples to the wall so you can see them in the light before committing.

mainEntity.name: How long will an exterior repaint last near the water?

acceptedAnswer.text: With the right system and proper preparation, a quality exterior repaint gives you many years of service. Harbour exposure is demanding, so the honest answer depends on the surface, the aspect and how much sun and salt it copes with. We will talk you through realistic expectations for your specific property at quote time.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle access on steep or narrow Mosman streets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plenty of Mosman blocks are steep and tight, especially down toward Beauty Point and the harbour. Access and safe set-up are part of our planning, and we allow for it in the quote rather than springing it on you later.

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home before the painters arrive?
